title: Paying/private passengers flown to space, by provider

source.name: Commercial human spaceflight tallies
source.publisher: Forbes, compiling Blue Origin and Virgin Galactic flight records

notes: Blue Origin: 92 space tourists flown on New Shepard since crewed flights began in 2021 (Forbes, 2026-05-24). Virgin Galactic: 23 space tourists flown in 22 years of the program (same source). SpaceX: at least 24 fully private/civilian passengers flown via Crew Dragon on Inspiration4 (2021, 4 people), Polaris Dawn (2024, 4 people), Fram2 (2025, 4 people) and three Axiom Space missions (Ax-1 through Ax-3, 4 people each) -- tallied from individually reported missions (Wikipedia: Crew Dragon Resilience, Polaris Dawn, Axiom Mission pages), not a single published total.
